Agent Name: Planner  
Step Number: 18  
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly concluded that "Tiger of the Seven Seas" was released earlier than "My Wife's Lodger." This mistake occurred because the Planner reversed the release dates of the two films. It stated that "Tiger of the Seven Seas" had an earliest release date in October 1952 (United Kingdom), which is incorrect since that date belongs to "My Wife's Lodger." "Tiger of the Seven Seas" had its earliest release in December 1962 (Italy). The Planner failed to accurately compare the release dates and incorrectly swapped them in the final conclusion.
